feedback_summary: The candidate presents a well-structured and authentic informal letter that fulfills all aspects of the prompt. The layout includes essential components including the address, date, salutation, body paragraphs, sign-off, and an envelope layout. While the content and originality are commendable, mechanical slips such as spelling errors ('prespective', 'Addres') and minor grammatical issues keep the score at 4 out of 5.
